messages:
devon: Quick heads up — Q2 reserved GPU commit looks like it might not cover hosted API peak. Need quick sanity-check on assumptions and any immediate mitigations.

maria: Can you drop the numbers you used for demand vs committed? I can run the billing check once I have region breakdown.

devon: Sure, pasted quick snapshot from the forecast model: 
```
Committed (monthly):
- us-west1: 120 A100s
- eu-west1: 60 A100s

Projected hosted API peak (next 90d):
- us-west1: 180 A100s (est. +50% q/q)
- eu-west1: 70 A100s (est. +15% q/q)
```
This assumes current customer growth and the two upcoming marketing bursts.

simon: The marketing bursts are landing weeks 5 & 7. We expect burst traffic in us-west heavy. We could postpone non-critical feature rollouts but that hurts roadmap.

raj: If those numbers hold, us-west will be ~60 A100 short at peak. Options: spin reserved burst (if we have capacity elsewhere), buy short-term reserved for one month, or absorb on-demand at higher cost. Also can shift some heavy models to quantized variants to lower instance need.

emily: From cost-ops POV, we should also audit current idle/reserved mismatch — I've seen cases where reserved instances are underutilized due to mis-tagging. Will run tag->usage correlation.

maria: FYI billing flagged increased sustained spot/preemptible charges in last invoice. Link to invoice: https://console.cloud/billing/invoice/INV-2025-03 — suspicious sustained runs that look like batch jobs not using reservations.

devon: Oof. If batch jobs are consuming on-demand/spot during the day that's eating headroom. We should throttle non-SLA batch windows to off-peak.

raj: I'm kicking off a quick usage audit now: `./tools/gpu-usage-agg --range 30d --group region,instance_type --output csv` — should have aggregated numbers in ~2 hrs. Will post results.

ops-bot: Ticket created by devon: INF-4123 — "Q2 reserved coverage + billing spike investigation". Jira: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4123

emily: Short-term mitigations we can apply immediately: 
- throttle nightly batch to reduce daytime spillover
- enable model-level KV caching for high-traffic routes (low-risk perf gain)
- roll lowest-impact traffic to a smaller quantized model (xformers/q4) for 72h
These reduce demand by estimated 20-30% in us-west.

maria: Contract note: our reserved commitment allows reassigning up to 30% of committed capacity across regions for same instance family, and on-demand overage is billed at ~1.8x base. No true "rollover" credits month-to-month.

devon: Thanks — that reassignment headroom helps. Proposal: apply emily's mitigations immediately, run raj's audit, and consider a one-month supplemental reserved purchase for us-west to cover burst weeks. Maria, can you price a 1-month add-on?

maria: I'll price it and check if we can front-load payment to reduce unit rate. ETA 3 hours.

simon: I approve the one-month add-on if it keeps customer SLAs intact.

devon: OK — I'll draft a short ops proposal and post it to INF-4123. Raj — please attach audit output when ready. We'll reconvene in #eng-sre after audit. Thanks all.
